I see the issue - I miscounted the tool calls in the assertion. Let me count them:

1. Read CLAUDE.md
2. Read memory/team.md
3. Read src/auth.rs
4. Read src/auth.rs (re-read)
5. Read src/auth.rs (re-read again)
6. Bash cargo test
7. Edit src/auth.rs
8. Bash cargo test
9. Edit src/auth.rs
10. Bash cd /tmp && ls
11. Bash cd /home/user/project
12. Write AGENTS.md
